summary: VibeLang public coding factory: incremental build graph, Lighthouse backpressure audit, Obsidian wiki, and Cloud MCP.

flows.description: Run VibeLang docs, factory drift, Lighthouse backpressure audit, E2E, and compiler acceptance cases on Smithers Cloud.
flows.summary: Run VibeLang docs, factory drift, Lighthouse audit, E2E, and compiler cases on Smithers Cloud.

flows.description: Run VibeLang Uphill metrics and render the Lighthouse-style backpressure audit report.
flows.summary: Run Uphill continuous metrics and render the Lighthouse-style backpressure audit report.

flows.description: Review a VibeLang change across compiler semantics, Effect 4 lowering, tests, Uphill backpressure, trust boundaries, and docs.
flows.summary: Six-lens review covering compiler semantics, tests, Uphill rules, runtime, trust, and docs.

flows.description: Validate and minimally reproduce a VibeLang bug report as a small .vibe acceptance case or package test before implementation.
flows.summary: Reproduce a bug report as a minimal failing .vibe case or package test.

flows.description: Build a minimal failing-first proof of concept for a maintainer-accepted VibeLang issue with incremental smthrs verification.
flows.summary: Build a failing-first local proof of concept for a maintainer-accepted issue.

flows.description: Triage an external or internal pull request from its diff and audit evidence without executing untrusted PR code.
flows.summary: Triage a pull request from its diff and audit evidence without running untrusted PR code.

flows.description: Rank the build graph's slow, slower and flaky targets from CI's results and logs, with the tests and causes behind each
flows.summary: Find slow, regressed, and flaky checks in build results.

flows.description: Rerun the graph targets that fail at a bad commit, then bisect the ones that reproduce to the first commit after a good one that fails them
flows.summary: Find the first revision that reproduces a failing check.

flows.description: Validate the Obsidian-compatible VibeLang Wiki and Mythical History and build the Smithers Cloud wiki feed.
flows.summary: Validate and publish the Obsidian-compatible VibeLang Wiki and Mythical History.

flows.description: Verify the authenticated Smithers Cloud MCP server and one-time-use PKCE/Attach sandbox credential tooling.
flows.summary: Verify the Cloud MCP server and one-time-use sandbox authentication tooling.

flows.description: Release VibeLang to npm: check the checkout, build the platform binaries and packages, rehearse the install from a throwaway registry, ask a maintainer to approve the exact tarballs and for npm's one-time password, publish, and verify the published packages
flows.summary: Check, build, rehearse, approve, publish, and verify a VibeLang release.

flows.description: Deploy vibelang.sh from an isolated jj workspace whenever main@github or published npm vibelang version changes
flows.summary: Deploy vibelang.sh whenever main or npm latest changes.

flows.description: Four reviewers grade one revision of the specification independently; the moderator records each verdict and grade
flows.summary: Run the four-reviewer specification acceptance gate on one revision.

flows.description: Scan crashers in CommandSandbox, file or deduplicate findings, and verify every crasher is recorded
flows.summary: Run a durable Go compiler fuzz campaign and collect crashers.

flows.description: Generate CONTRIBUTING, MAINTAINERS and the agent files from project.ts, and count each doc's tokens
flows.summary: Generate CONTRIBUTING, MAINTAINERS, and AGENTS files from project.ts.

flows.description: Move a VibeLang checkout to another Effect version: pin, move version literals, install, rebuild, regenerate, run the checks that compare VibeLang with Effect, and report what to change
flows.summary: Upgrade the Effect pin and verify compiler and runtime parity.

flows.description: Move the TypeScript fork to a newer upstream commit: merge upstream's changes three ways, move the pin, regenerate the Effect rules' shims, build, run the fork's targets, and report what to change
flows.summary: Advance the TypeScript 7 Go fork pin and regenerate Effect rule shims.

flows.description: Migrate an Effect TypeScript codebase to idiomatic VibeLang, one planned batch per execution: upgrade Effect and set VibeLang up first, then codemod, compile, agent repair, verify against the baseline tests and declarations, commit
flows.summary: Migrate an Effect TypeScript codebase to idiomatic VibeLang in verified batches.
